item.title: Version 1.3.91
item.description:
- The photo-driven accent color now tints the whole app: sidebar selection and glow, logo tile, background glow, Publish Site button and progress indicators.
- Sidebar buttons spring and highlight on hover (icons swell, labels slide), in rounded type with monospace section labels.
- New ⌘K command palette: type to jump to any section, save to website, or check for updates. Plain navigation is listed first so Return never triggers an action by accident.
- Home action tiles fit on one row at smaller window sizes.
